subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw solve pre-processing acknowledgement text as shared messages.ackText config, a non-terminal send-and-continue hook, or channel-specific placeholder features only?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but every plausible fix adds shared config or plugin/channel API surface and changes visible message delivery across multiple channels.

options.title: Approve Shared Ack Text Config
options.body: Add a default-off shared acknowledgement text contract with scope and per-channel/account overrides, plus schema, docs, and channel delivery tests.

options.title: Add Non-Terminal Hook First
options.body: Expose a typed plugin/channel hook that can send interim text and continue normal dispatch, leaving policy to plugins or channel owners.

options.title: Keep Placeholders Channel-Specific
options.body: Use the narrower Telegram, Slack, Discord, and Feishu items to decide UX per channel instead of adding a shared core contract now.

recommendation.title: Approve Shared Ack Text Config
recommendation.body: Add a default-off shared acknowledgement text contract with scope and per-channel/account overrides, plus schema, docs, and channel delivery tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review context and recent cross-channel dispatch/acknowledgement work make steipete the best available owner for the API/product boundary decision.
